assemblyStages.note: Round 30 decision: stages are the game slot combinations. The v5 partial-skin S2 (Skin_Lower_P1-P3 on, P4 open) is REMOVED - the game has a single skin slot, so the intermediate state is not displayable and is no longer part of the contract.
assemblyStages.S0: launch-pad + support-tower + control-terminal (+ owned equipment per equipmentPlacement); no rocket
assemblyStages.S1: S0 + rocket frame slot only (frame nodes visible; propulsion/capsule off; skin off)
assemblyStages.S2: S1 + propulsion slot on; parts-rack on site
assemblyStages.S3: S2 + capsule slot on; skin slot on; hatch_open/bay_open posed at end frame on the ground; corridor detached; parts-rack on site
assemblyStages.S4: complete: skin on (frame nodes hidden), corridor attached, tower arms engaged, parts-rack removed

animationsVerified: Round 30 full check (tools/verify_round30.py, all 8 clips sampled at 0/50/100% on the shipped GLBs): durations - hatch_open/close 0.83s, bay_open/close 0.83s, corridor_retract 1.50s, tower_retract 2.50s, mount_release 0.62s, beacon_spin 2.04s loop. hatch_open end: panel swings out to x -2.07..-1.00 at y 17.7..18.2, clear of the capsule. bay_open end: panel swings out to z 3.26, clear of fins and tower. corridor_retract end (site space): nearest point x -2.51 vs rocket body radius 1.7 -> 0.81 m clearance; fins are far below its height band. tower_retract end: tower max x -4.40 (site) vs fin tip -2.55 -> 1.85 m clearance. mount_release end: hold arms rotate out and down; arm tops (pad y <= 2.15) stay below the fin/nozzle underside (site y >= 2.5) -> 0.35 m vertical clearance. Game timing VERDICT: OK as-is (retract starts +3s: corridor done 4.5s, tower done 5.5s; mount release +5s..5.62s; ascent +7s - at least 1.38 s margin everywhere). Note: tower_retract is the long pole (2.5 s); any future shortening of the sequence must keep >= 2.5 s between retract start and ascent.
